description: Recipe for tools/import_real_track.py: Anglesey Circuit / Trac Mon (Ty Croes, Anglesey, Wales), the International layout with the Coastal, National and Club layouts sharing its base (all four current layouts). Data notes: docs/real-tracks/anglesey.md.
name: Anglesey
trackDescription: Anglesey Circuit (Trac Mon), International (3.30 km), Coastal (2.47 km), National (1.91 km) and Club (1.28 km) layouts from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Welsh Government / NRW LIDAR composite DTM (1 m). Open, windswept coastal headland with the sea on three sides and Snowdonia to the east.
layoutSource: Wikipedia and racingcircuits.info (International Grand Prix Circuit 2006-to-date map): the full lap, Target - Banking - Church - School - Rocket - Peel - Seamans - Corkscrew - Tom Pryce Straight - Hairpin - Bus Stop; 3.380 km. One of the four current layouts (International, Coastal, National, Club).
directionSource: racingcircuits.info International map: arrows along the start straight towards Turn 1 and down past Church (clockwise); BRSCC 2021 briefing notes and the track guides (visordown.com) run the same way.
startFinishSource: OSM node 'Start/Finish' (11458386749) on the pit straight by the 2007 pits and control tower; racingcircuits.info International map: the chequered flag on that straight between the Bus Stop and Turn 1.

altLayouts.name: Coastal
altLayouts.layoutSource: Wikipedia and racingcircuits.info Coastal Circuit map: the International with the Corkscrew link from Seamans to the Bus Stop in place of the Tom Pryce Straight and Hairpin; 2.494 km.
altLayouts.directionSource: racingcircuits.info Coastal map: arrows as on the International (clockwise).
altLayouts.startFinishSource: racingcircuits.info Coastal map: the chequered flag at the same place as the International's, so the Coastal shares its line and grid (BRSCC 2021 briefing notes: one start procedure for both).

altLayouts.name: National
altLayouts.layoutSource: Wikipedia (National Circuit, 1.931 km) and racingcircuits.info National Circuit map: School Corner (OSM way 108374691) from the end of the return straight, Rocket, Peel, Seamans, the Tom Pryce Straight, the Hairpin and the return straight.
altLayouts.directionSource: ACU news 2012 (Wirral 100 on the National Circuit): the lap starts with 'the sweeping uphill right-handed School Corner', then Rocket and Peel, the first part of the Corkscrew and two long straights split by the Hairpin; racingcircuits.info National map arrows: down the return straight, up the Tom Pryce Straight (clockwise).

startFinish.note: On the return straight beside the National pit lane (OSM 'Pit Lane (National)' runs along it from 114 to 356 m).

altLayouts.startFinishSource: ACU news 2012: the National Circuit uses 'the original (pre-2007) start-line and pit lane'; racingcircuits.info National map: the chequered flag on the return straight beside the National pit lane (OSM ways 1238070257/264841296 'Pit Lane (National)').
altLayouts.startGridNote: The return straight behind the National line falls at 4.2-5.2 % from 70 m back (the grid rule allows 4 %), so the timing line goes 66 m back and the pole stands 26 m past the line.

altLayouts.name: Club
altLayouts.layoutSource: Wikipedia (Club Circuit, 1.287 km) and racingcircuits.info Club Circuit map: the start straight, Turn 1 (Target), the Banking, Church, then the Club Hairpin (OSM way 264840722) back onto the start straight.
altLayouts.directionSource: racingcircuits.info Club map: the arrow on the start straight points to Turn 1, the one past the Banking down towards Church (clockwise).

startFinish.note: On the start straight 22 m after the Club Hairpin joins it, 37 % of the way from the junction to Target as on the map.

altLayouts.startFinishSource: racingcircuits.info Club Circuit map: the chequered flag on the start straight just after the Club Hairpin joins it. OSM's 'Start/Finish' node (the International/Coastal line) lies 34 m before that junction, which the Club lap doesn't pass, so the Club line is placed 22 m after the junction (37 % of the way to Target, as on the map).
altLayouts.startGridNote: The Club Hairpin joins the start straight 12 m behind the Club line, so the grid can't stand behind it: the timing line goes 2 m back (pipeline._line_lead) and the grid runs on towards Target, pole 90 m past the line. Real Club races grid on the International straight, which the Club lap doesn't drive.

sharpWaysNote: The Bus Stop (OSM 892471229) is the tight chicane before the start/finish line (MSV map, track guides); the importer's 5 m smoothing rounded it to a 29 m radius S, so it is kept sharp (tools/import_real_track.py, sharpWays; Oulton Park's Hislop's read as a kink in game, 2026-10-23).

startFinish.note: OSM node 'Start/Finish' on the pit straight.

expectedCornerOrderNote: Driving order of the named corners (clockwise). Seamans is the downhill left at the start of the Corkscrew way (not named in OSM, so not labelled).
kerbsNote: No kerb overrides: OSM has no kerb or run-off features here (Overpass 2026-10-19: barrier=kerb, kerb=*, area:highway=*, racing:kerb none; guard rails and a tyre wall only), the 1 m DTM can't resolve kerbs, and the track guides found (visordown.com, markhales.com) don't place any. Every corner gets the geometric apex/exit kerbs.
runoffNote: Run-off surfaces, barriers (type, offset, debris fences) and trees measured from open LIDAR and OSM plus published sources: tools/real_tracks/runoff|vegetation/<slug>.json (tools/real_tracks_data/measure_runoff.py, runoff_evidence.json); docs/real-tracks.md, Run-off and foliage.
